data.narrative:
Trilobio is a Seed-stage biotech company founded by Roya Amini-Naieni and Maximilian Schommer that has raised $11M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparative universe of 3 public peers in Biotech & Health (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers including Colossal Biosciences, Abridge, and Recursion Pharmaceuticals.

Of three valuation methods examined, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method uses total capital raised ($11M) as a proxy for post-money valuation at Seed and applies a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of progression to the next funding round, yielding $28M. Peer-Median analysis could not be executed due to absence of sufficient same-stage or adjacent-stage comparables meeting screening thresholds; while 8 private peers exist in the sector, none qualified the narrow filter criteria. Public-Comp Anchoring was not viable because Trilobio, like most private companies, does not disclose revenue; the 3 public biotech comparables trade at a sector median P/S of 6.6x, but cannot be applied without target revenue data.

The single-method triangulation supports a valuation range of $23M to $32M, with a median point of $28M. Key uncertainties include the absence of direct peer valuation benchmarks at identical stage and the lack of revenue visibility necessary for multiple-based anchoring. Refinement would require either disclosure of recent term sheet economics or revenue trajectory.
